description: The bar chart illustrates a runtime comparison of different models, specifically contrasting a proposed framework against various large language models. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing the different models evaluated: "Our Joint Framework", "ChatGPT", "DeepSeek", "LLaMA", and "Claude". The vertical axis is the value axis, labeled "Runtime (seconds)", featuring a linear scale that ranges from 50 to 400 with regularly spaced tick marks at intervals of 50. Horizontal dashed grid lines extend from these tick marks across the chart area. A legend in the upper left corner indicates the color coding used for the bars: dark green represents "Our Joint Framework" and light blue represents "LLM Models". There are five vertical bars, each outlined in black and annotated with its exact numerical value in bold text above the bar. The first bar, labeled "Our Joint Framework", is colored dark green and represents the shortest runtime at 77 seconds. The remaining four bars are colored light blue, representing the LLM models. "ChatGPT" has a runtime of 190 seconds, "DeepSeek" represents the tallest bar with a runtime of 365 seconds, "LLaMA" has a runtime of 172 seconds, and "Claude" has a runtime of 243 seconds. The bars are not sorted in strictly ascending or descending order by value, but rather appear to be ordered to separate the proposed framework from the baseline LLM models. The exact values are visually emphasized through bold annotations above each corresponding bar, and the entire chart is presented with a slight rotational tilt.
